scope: train split only for stats, correlations and IC (labels computed from prices <= train end); validation only as feature coverage, no labels
ic_definition: per-date Spearman(feature, excess_ret) over labelled train rows, dates with >= 30 tickers; CI = moving-block bootstrap of the mean, block 10

ret_1d.hypothesis: 1-day reversal: yesterday's winners give back part of the move (liquidity provision).

ret_5d.hypothesis: 1-week reversal; the strongest naive baseline on train.

mom_12_1.hypothesis: Classic 12-1 momentum: skips the last month to separate it from reversal.

ex_ret_1d.hypothesis: 1-day return relative to the equal-weight market; the target is relative too.

ex_ret_5d.hypothesis: 5-day relative return; same construction as the reversal baseline input.

rank_ret_5d.hypothesis: Rank of 5-day return on t: robust to outliers and to market-wide moves.

zret_5d.hypothesis: Reversal scaled by the stock's own volatility: a 5% drop means more for a calm stock.

ex_ret_1d_lag1.hypothesis: Shape of the past week: relative return 1 day before t.

ex_ret_1d_lag2.hypothesis: Shape of the past week: relative return 2 days before t.

ex_ret_1d_lag3.hypothesis: Shape of the past week: relative return 3 days before t.

ex_ret_1d_lag4.hypothesis: Shape of the past week: relative return 4 days before t.

frac_up_21d.hypothesis: Share of up-days: steady gains vs a few jumps carry different information.

vol_21d.hypothesis: Low-volatility anomaly: volatile stocks underperform on a risk-adjusted basis.

vol_ratio_21_63.hypothesis: Rising volatility often follows news or stress.

skew_63d.hypothesis: Lottery preference: positively skewed stocks are overpriced.

max_ret_21d.hypothesis: MAX effect: stocks with extreme recent up-days underperform.

min_ret_21d.hypothesis: Recent crash days: forced selling can overshoot and rebound.

beta_63d.hypothesis: Betting-against-beta: high-beta stocks earn less than their risk implies.

xvol_63d.hypothesis: Volatility of returns relative to the market (idiosyncratic risk).

corr_mkt_63d.hypothesis: Low market correlation leaves more room for stock-specific moves.

parkinson_vol_21d.hypothesis: High-low (Parkinson) volatility: more efficient than close-to-close.

hl_range_1d.hypothesis: Wide daily range signals disagreement or news.

avg_range_21d.hypothesis: Average daily range: an alternative volatility estimate using highs and lows.

close_loc_1d.hypothesis: Closing near the day's high shows buying pressure into the close.

intraday_ret_1d.hypothesis: Open-to-close move, separated from the overnight gap.

overnight_ret_5d.hypothesis: Overnight returns over a week (news, earnings) behave differently from intraday ones.

intraday_ret_5d.hypothesis: Intraday returns over a week (trading pressure).

dist_ma_10.hypothesis: Short-term stretch from the 10-day average tends to revert.

ma_ratio_50_200.hypothesis: Golden/death cross as a continuous variable.

dist_high_21.hypothesis: Distance from the 1-month high: short-term overbought/oversold.

dist_high_252.hypothesis: 52-week-high anchoring: stocks near their high keep outperforming.

rsi_14.hypothesis: Overbought/oversold oscillator (share of up-moves in 14 days).

bb_pos_20.hypothesis: Bollinger position: price stretch in units of its own volatility.

volu_ratio_1_21.hypothesis: Unusual volume today marks news or attention.

volu_ratio_5_63.hypothesis: A week of elevated volume vs the quarter.

rank_volu_ratio_1_21.hypothesis: Rank of today's volume surge across stocks on t.

ret_x_volume_1d.hypothesis: Moves on heavy volume (information) reverse less than moves on light volume (noise).

rank_dollar_vol_63d.hypothesis: Size/liquidity proxy: smaller, less liquid stocks behave differently.

rank_amihud_21d.hypothesis: Illiquidity (|return| per dollar traded): an illiquidity premium.

div_yield_252d.hypothesis: Trailing dividend yield: value and defensiveness.

mkt_ret_21d.hypothesis: Market regime: reversal and momentum strength depend on recent market moves.

xs_dispersion_21d.hypothesis: Cross-sectional dispersion: how much room there is for stock picking.

mkt_ret_21d.note: constant across tickers on a date; no cross-sectional IC

mkt_vol_21d.note: constant across tickers on a date; no cross-sectional IC

xs_dispersion_21d.note: constant across tickers on a date; no cross-sectional IC
